pr_title: Remove illusion of caching in the inventory script plugin
pr_body:
##### SUMMARY
Fixes #64141

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bugfix Pull Request

##### COMPONENT NAME
lib/ansible/plugins/inventory/script.py
pr_comments:
I know at one point we had caching for the script plugin, and then subsequently removed it. Potentially due to the script itself also implementing caching.  bcoca might remember.

Unsure if that is important or not, but figured I'd mention it.

@sivel depends on the script in question. ec2.py has its own caching (only file-backed, and may be turned off), for instance. But it isn't guaranteed in general and will let people use common settings/cache plugins rather than whatever the script is doing.
Yeah, that was an assumption on my part. I don't remember the real reason, and I couldn't find the PR that removed the caching, only the one that initially added it.
it was removed (among other things) because the plugin cannot detect if the cache should be refreshed, so leaving to each script to deal with it.
Oh! Is that because the cache key is not unique per script?
among other things, also ... cache was broken when initially added, we reverted but i forgot to remove settings from script plugin.
Primarily a whitespace change now - https://github.com/ansible/ansible/pull/64151/files?w=1 to see the diff without that.

I set cache settings in inventory and inventory plugin script ini section according to the docs, but cache isn't created. I tried with jsonfile cache plugin.

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bug Report

##### COMPONENT NAME
<!--- Write the short name of the module, plugin, task or feature below, use your best guess if unsure -->
<!--- !component =lib/ansible/plugins/inventory/script.py-->
inventory plugin script
##### ANSIBLE VERSION

1. Set configuration file for inventory cache with jsonfile plugin
2. Run playbook with invetory script plugin source

##### EXPECTED RESULTS
<!--- Describe what you expected to happen when running the steps above -->
JSON inventory file in /tmp folder

##### ACTUAL RESULTS
<!--- Describe what actually happened. If possible run with extra verbosity (-vvvv) -->
JSON inventory file isn't created
